# One runtime call per line, played by tests/test_love_runtime.c through the
# C runtime and by main.lua through game/p8/ and game/love/. `frame` ends a
# frame; integers are decimal or 0x hex.
cls
frame
# pset: corners, every colour, off-screen on each side, under a camera.
pset 0 0 7
pset 159 0 8
pset 0 119 9
pset 159 119 10
pset 10 10 0
pset 11 10 1
pset 12 10 2
pset 13 10 3
pset 14 10 4
pset 15 10 5
pset 16 10 6
pset 17 10 11
pset 18 10 12
pset 19 10 13
pset 20 10 14
pset 21 10 15
pset -1 5 7
pset 160 5 7
pset 5 -1 7
pset 5 120 7
pset -2000000 5 7
camera -20 30
pset 0 0 12
pset 140 -30 13
pset -21 50 7
pset 0 90 7
frame
# psets: runs of one colour, colour changes, off-screen points inside a run,
# the camera of the previous frame carried over.
psets 30 40 8 31 40 8 32 40 8 33 40 9 34 40 9 35 40 8
psets 40 50 3 -100 50 3 41 50 3 300 50 3 42 50 3
psets 1 1 7
camera 0 0
psets 0 0 14 159 119 15 158 119 15
frame
# rectfill without a pattern: corners in either order, one pixel, a line,
# partly and wholly off screen, the whole screen and beyond, a colour byte
# with a high nibble (masked to the low one), under a camera.
rectfill -5 -5 200 200 1
rectfill 10 10 20 15 8
rectfill 40 30 30 20 9
rectfill 50 50 50 50 7
rectfill 60 5 90 5 11
rectfill 150 110 170 130 12
rectfill -10 60 3 70 13
rectfill 200 10 220 20 14
rectfill 10 -30 20 -1 14
rectfill 100 60 120 80 0x5a
camera 15 -10
rectfill 0 0 10 10 2
rectfill 160 100 180 140 3
rectfill -5000 50 5000 52 4
camera 0 0
frame
